records.title: Green MLOps to Green GenOps: An Empirical Study of Energy Consumption in Discriminative and Generative AI Operations
records.reason: 一次本文はLLM requestのenergy-per-sample、RPS、cache hitを計測しserving運用との接点がある。一方でモデル/運用を改善する新しい推論手法ではなく、単一の測定研究で一般化も限定されるため、system efficiency evidenceとしてborderlineに留める。

records.title: Efficient computation using spatial-photonic Ising machines with low-rank and circulant matrix constraints
records.reason: Nature一次要旨で対象はspatial-photonic Ising machineによる組合せ最適化で、低ランク・circulant結合行列と光学ハードウェア精度を扱う。LLM推論アクセラレータではなく別の物理計算モデルである。

records.title: Adaptive sparse lightweight multi-scale hybrid network for remote sensing image semantic segmentation
records.reason: Elsevier DOI record was inaccessible. The title identifies remote-sensing semantic segmentation, whose relation to inference systems is unclear without primary abstract details; do not exclude from title alone, retain as borderline.

records.title: ReViT: Vision Transformer Accelerator With Reconfigurable Semantic-Aware Differential Attention
records.reason: IEEE DOI record was inaccessible. The title indicates a semantic-aware Vision Transformer accelerator and its linked lineage is sparse attention; without primary abstract/body the attention mechanism and LLM transfer cannot be verified, so retain as borderline.

records.title: NeoBERT: A Next-Generation BERT
records.reason: 一次本文にはencoder-only NeoBERTの効率・sequence length分析があるが、目的は小型BERT事前学習/embedding性能であり、decoder-only LLMのautoregressive inferenceやserving改善ではない。Transformer設計上の参考性は残るが、直接対象としては弱い。
